info.title: FraudShield AI — Machine Learning Service
info.description: Production-ready inference service for credit card fraud detection and risk monitoring. Provides probabilistic risk scoring, calibrated risk categorization, batch inference, and SHAP feature attribution explanations.

get.summary: Check service health and model readiness
get.description: Returns service availability and whether the machine learning model pipeline is loaded and ready for inference.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT bearer token
post.description: Validates email and password, checks active status, and returns a signed access token.

get.description: Returns public profile details and role of the currently logged-in user.

post.description: Logs a logout audit event. For stateless JWT tokens, client must discard the token.

schema.title: Response Logout Api V1 Auth Logout Post

get.summary: List all users with pagination and filters (Admin only)
get.description: Returns a paginated collection of registered user accounts.

post.summary: Create a new user account (Admin only)
post.description: Registers an Analyst, Auditor, or Admin account with modern password hashing.

get.summary: Get user details by ID (Admin only)
get.description: Returns public profile information for a specific user.

patch.summary: Update user profile, role, or active status (Admin only)
patch.description: Allows updating user role, activating/deactivating, or updating password. Prevents deactivating the last active admin.

get.summary: Retrieve active model metadata and metrics
get.description: Returns public model specifications, features, trained thresholds, and evaluation metrics without exposing filesystem paths or credentials.

post.summary: Score fraud risk for a single transaction
post.description: Evaluates a single credit card transaction feature vector against the fitted ML pipeline. Strictly validates feature schema, rejects non-finite values and unrecognized fields, and computes fraud probability, calibrated risk score, and risk category.

schema.description: Whether to include SHAP feature attribution explanations

get.summary: List transactions with pagination and risk filters
get.description: Returns a paginated list of stored transactions, optionally filtered by risk level or predicted class.
Returns full transaction details, anonymized PCA features, and latest prediction summary.

get.summary: Retrieve prediction evaluation history for a transaction
get.description: Returns all historical prediction snapshots recorded for this transaction, ordered newest first.

post.summary: Open an investigation case for a transaction
post.description: Creates an investigation case in OPEN status. Requires ANALYST or ADMIN role.

409.description: An investigation case already exists for this transaction.

get.description: Returns paginated investigation cases. Administrators and Auditors view all cases; Analysts view assigned cases and permitted unassigned cases.
Returns case details, associated transaction, latest prediction, and chronological notes.

403.description: Access denied. Case is assigned to another analyst.

patch.description: Update status, analyst assignment, or description with state machine validation.

404.description: Case or assigned user not found.

post.summary: Add an investigation note to a case
post.description: Adds an append-only chronological note. Cannot add notes to closed cases. Auditor denied.

422.description: Cannot add notes to a closed case.

get.summary: List investigation notes for a case
get.description: Returns notes in chronological order (oldest first). Safe author profiles.
Returns paginated immutable audit logs with optional filters and deterministic ordering. Strictly accessible only to ADMIN and AUDITOR roles. Read-only.

get.description: Returns top-level metric cards including total transactions, evaluation counts, model-predicted fraud rate, average risk score, and investigation case pipeline counts. Uses the latest prediction per transaction to prevent double counting. Accessible to ADMIN, ANALYST, and AUDITOR roles.

get.summary: Get current risk tier and classification distribution
get.description: Returns the distribution of transactions across risk categories (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH) and binary classification decisions (predicted fraud vs legitimate). Strictly evaluated on the latest prediction for each transaction. Accessible to ADMIN, ANALYST, and AUDITOR roles.

get.summary: Get transaction and prediction time-series trends
get.description: Returns time-series metrics aggregated by hourly or daily buckets. Includes prediction evaluation volume, distinct transaction volume, flagged fraud counts, and average risk score. Accessible to ADMIN, ANALYST, and AUDITOR roles.

400.description: Invalid interval or date range exceeding limit.

get.description: Returns case counts and proportions by status (OPEN, IN_REVIEW, CONFIRMED_FRAUD, LEGITIMATE, CLOSED), along with assignment stats and average resolution time in seconds. Accessible to ADMIN, ANALYST, and AUDITOR roles.

get.summary: Get aggregated model explanation feature importance
get.description: Aggregates SHAP feature attribution contributions across high-risk transaction predictions. Returns top features ranked by mean absolute contribution to explain primary risk drivers. Accessible to ADMIN, ANALYST, and AUDITOR roles.

400.description: Invalid risk level or date range parameters.
